column1: # Format: category<TAB>regex<TAB>suggestion (UTF-8, one rule per line).
# Regex: .NET syntax, matched case-insensitively against each paragraph (its consecutive text lines, comments removed,
#        joined by a space); use (?-i:...) for a case-sensitive part. Lines starting with # and empty lines are skipped.
# Categories: filler (deletable), wordy (a shorter form says the same), hype (a quality claim instead of evidence),
#             hedge (uncertainty without content), meta (text about the text), ai-tic (patterns of LLM-written text),
#             grammar (errors typical of a Slovak author), spelling (typos and draft residue).
# Rules behind the list: knowledge/writing/academic-style.md, sections 3, 4 and 6 to 10.
# A hit is not automatically an error: the script points, the reader decides. A new habit gets a new line.
# Precision over recall: a pattern that mostly flags correct text is narrowed or removed.
# Built into check-text.ps1, so not repeated here: doubled words, lower-case "lemma~\ref", \cite glued to a word,
# "e.g."/"i.e." without a comma, British spellings, contractions, $$, TODO markers, sentences over the word limit.

column1: # --- grammar: errors typical of a Slovak author (academic-style.md section 10) -----------------------------------

column3: 'allows us to X' / 'allows X-ing' (the verb needs an object)
'work' is uncountable here: prior work / earlier papers / studies
no article before a numbered reference: 'by Claim~19'
missing article: 'a shortest path', 'the smallest cut'
the verb is 'prove'; 'proof' is the noun
SK 'platí, že': delete and state the formula
no comma after 'such that' (Slovak comma rule)
not English usage: write 'or', or two sentences; 'respectively' goes at the end
false friend: SK 'eventuálne' = 'possibly'; English 'eventually' = 'in the end'
a citation is not a noun: 'Gomory and Hu~\cite{...} showed'
a citation is not a noun: name the authors before \cite (or \citet in author-year styles)
spelling borrowed from Slovak, or wrong plural
two verbs in a row: draft residue
two determiners in a row: draft residue
